operations.description: The Adult Content Detection function classifies the documents as adult or noadult based on their context. It can be used to detect whether a document contains content unsuitable for minors.
operations.summary: Classifies the Document as adult or noadult
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] adult content detection [PATH] 1 0 adult content detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Commercial Detection function labels the documents as commercial or non-commercial based on their keywords and expressions. It can be used to detect whether a website is commercial or not.
operations.summary: Classifies the Document as commercial or nocommercial
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] commercial detection [PATH] 1 0 commercial detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Document Similarity function estimates the degree of similarity between two documents. It can be used to detect duplicate webpages or detect plagiarism.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] document similarity [PATH] 1 0 document similarity json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The Educational Detection function classifies the documents as educational or non-educational based on their context. It can be used to detect whether a website is educational or not.
operations.summary: Classifies the Document as educational or noeducational
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] educational detection [PATH] 1 0 educational detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Gender Detection function identifies if a particular document is written-by or targets-to a man or a woman based on the context, the words and the idioms found in the text.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] gender detection [PATH] 1 0 gender detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Keyword Extraction function enables you to extract from an arbitrary document all the keywords and word-combinations along with their occurrences in the text.
operations.summary: Extracts the Keywords of the Document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] keyword extraction [PATH] 1 0 keyword extraction json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The Language Detection function identifies the natural language of the given document based on its words and context. This classifier is able to detect 96 different languages.
operations.summary: Identifies the Language of the Document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] language detection [PATH] 1 0 language detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Readability Assessment function determines the degree of readability of a document based on its terms and idioms. The texts are classified as basic, intermediate and advanced depending their difficulty.
operations.summary: Evaluates the Readability of the Document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] readability assessment [PATH] 1 0 readability assessment json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Sentiment Analysis function classifies documents as positive, negative or neutral (lack of sentiment) depending on whether they express a positive, negative or neutral opinion.
operations.summary: Identifies the Sentiment of the Document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] sentiment analysis [PATH] 1 0 sentiment analysis json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Spam Detection function labels documents as spam or nospam by taking into account their context. It can be used to filter out spam emails and comments.
operations.summary: Classifies the Document as spam or nospam
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] spam detection [PATH] 1 0 spam detection json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Subjectivity Analysis function categorizes documents as subjective or objective based on their writing style. Texts that express personal opinions are labeled as subjective and the others as objective.
operations.summary: Classifies Document as Subjective or Objective
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] subjectivity analysis [PATH] 1 0 subjectivity analysis json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Text Extraction function enables you to extract the important information from a given webpage. Extracting the clear text of the documents is an important step before any other analysis.
operations.summary: Extracts the clear text from Webpage
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] text extraction [PATH] 1 0 text extraction json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description: The Topic Classification function assigns documents in 12 thematic categories based on their keywords, idioms and jargon. It can be used to identify the topic of the texts.
operations.summary: Identifies the Topic of the Document
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] topic classification [PATH] 1 0 topic classification json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] adult content detection

operations.description: The Twitter Sentiment Analysis function allows you to perform Sentiment Analysis on Twitter. It classifies the tweets as positive, negative or neutral depending on their context.
operations.summary: Identifies the Sentiment of Twitter Messages
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] twitter sentiment analysis [PATH] 1 0 twitter sentiment analysis json [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]
